P.name: Ki Barrier
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} After completing an {{tip|champion ability|ability's}} effects, '''Shen''' grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for {{pp|47 + (120-47)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ 13% '''bonus''' health)}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds. If '''Shen''' affects at least one other {{tip|champion}} with an ability, ''Ki Barrier's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by {{pp|4 to 8 for 18; then +0.125*x for 2|formula=4 + 4 / 17 * (level - 1) until level 18, then +0.125 per level}} seconds.
P.description2: '''Shen''' manifests a {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} that he can control with ''{{ai|Twilight Assault|Shen}}'' and ''{{ai|Spirit's Refuge|Shen}}''.

Q.name: Twilight Assault
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shen''' recalls his {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} to him. Enemy champions hit by the {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} along its path are {{tip|slow|slowed}} for the next 2 seconds while moving away from '''Shen'''.
Q.description2: Once it arrives, '''Shen''' empowers his next 3 {{tip|basic attacks}} within 8 seconds to gain {{sti|range|75 '''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}. Against {{tip|structures}}, only the flat damage portion is applied.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{pp|10 to 40 for 6|1 to 16}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2 to 4}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)|health}}|Total Magic Damage|{{pp|10*3 to 40*3 for 6|1 to 16}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2*3 to 4*3}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|4.5}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)|health}}}}
Q.description3: If the {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} during the travel, the attacks are further enhanced to deal {{ccs|{{as|'''increased bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} and additionally grant '''Shen''' {{sti|as|{{as|50% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
Q.leveling3: {{st|Increased Bonus Damage|{{pp|10 to 40 for 6|1 to 16}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5 to 7}}% {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)|health}}|Total Increased Damage|{{pp|10*3 to 40*3 for 6|1 to 16}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*3 to 7*3}}% {{as|(+ 6% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)|health}}}}
Q.description4: Empowered attacks against {{tip|monsters}} deal 100% '''bonus''' damage, but their '''total''' damage is capped.

W.name: Spirit's Refuge
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shen''' primes his {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}}, creating an area around it. After 2 seconds, or when '''Shen''' or an allied champion enters the area, the {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} generates a protective zone for {{fd|1.75}} seconds, {{tip|block|blocking}} all non-{{tip|turret}} basic attacks that hit '''Shen''' or allied champions in the area.

E.name: Shadow Dash
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Dealing damage with ''{{ai|Twilight Assault|Shen}}'' or ''Shadow Dash'' restores {{sti|energy|{{as|{{pp|30 to 50 for 3|1;4;12}} energy}}}}.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shen''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemy {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}} he passes through and {{tip|taunt|taunting}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
E.description3: ''{{ai|Twilight Assault|Shen}} and {{ai|Spirit's Refuge|Shen}} can be cast during the dash.''

R.name: Stand United
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shen''' focuses his will, {{ccib|Stand United Minimap.png}} {{tip|channel|channeling|noimg=true}} for 3 seconds and granting the target allied champion a {{tip|shield}} for 5 seconds at the time of cast, increased by {{as|{{pp|type=target's '''missing''' health|key=%|0 to 60 for 7|key1=%|0 to 60|formula=1% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health. ''This is capped at 60% '''missing''' health.''}}|health}}.
R.leveling: {{st|Minimum Shield Strength|{{ap|120 to 320}} {{as|(+ 135% AP)}} {{as|(+ 15% of his '''bonus''' health)}}|Maximum Shield Strength|{{ap|120*1.6 to 320*1.6}} {{as|(+ 216% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15*1.6}}% of his '''bonus''' health)}}}}
R.description2: Upon completing the channel, '''Shen''' and his {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} {{tip|blink}} to the target ally's location, placed between them and the nearest enemy champion. '''Shen''' also {{tip|homing projectile destruction|destroys}} any {{tip|projectiles}} targeting him at the time of completion.
